summary: The .git/config guard now compares the file's own entries (keys and values, include directives as entries) instead of its bytes, leaves out keys matching the built-in branch.*.vscode-merge-base and the new run.git-config-ignore list, names up to three sorted changed keys in the exit-9 halt, and refuses patterns that would hide core, filter, include or includeif keys.
verified: vloop task gate T1 exited 0 and printed gate T1: ok; go test ./... passes with VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 unset; gofmt, go vet, go mod tidy -diff clean; linux and windows builds ok.
notes: Pure rules live in internal/gitcfg (Match, Protected). The guard reads entries with git config --file <path> --no-includes --list -z, resolving patterns once at snapshot; halt text is built in gitGuard.changed(), so call sites are unchanged. A config git cannot parse is held as one pseudo-key (unreadable) by digest. config.Key got a GitKeys flag; a protected pattern from set is a config.UsageError (exit 2), from env or file a bare ProtectedPatternError (exit 1), and run checks it right after ResolveBudgets. Besides the tests the brief names, TestDefaultsEveryRow (internal/config) and TestConfigListDefaults/TestConfigListJSONOrderAndNull (internal/cli) also pin the key list and had to gain the new key. The brief's hooks/config subtests of TestWorkedExampleB8 do not mention .git/config, so none changed there. docs/guide/commands.md is unchanged: no help text changed. When running go test inside a vloop session, unset VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 or TestTaskGate* fail.
